english:
<void Weakened /> enemies take <pve 15% /> <pvp [7.5%] /> increased damage and have 20% decreased Movement Speed for <pve 6 /> <pvp [2.5] /> seconds. PvE Combatants also become less accurate and slower.

Some sources apply a stronger <void Weaken /> effect, increasing damage received by:
• <void Shadowshot: Moebius />: <pve 30% /> <pvp [50%] /> against tethered enemies.
• <yellow Felwinter's Helm /> (Warlord's End): 30% against enemies hit by its weakening burst.
• <yellow Tractor Cannon /> (Repulsor Force) and <yellow Fafnir /> with Quantum Nova active: <pve 30% /> <pvp [50%] /> against enemies they damage.
• <void Shadowshot: Deadfall />: <pve 35% /> <pvp [50%?] /> against tethered enemies.

Applying another <void Weaken /> effect can extend the duration of the stronger debuffs from <yellow Fafnir />, <yellow Felwinter's Helm />, and <yellow Tractor Cannon />.

// Shadowshot: Deadfall's PvP damage increase is marked 50%? in the source.

source.text:
Weakened Enemies receive 15% [7.5%] increased damage and 20% Decreased Movement Speed for 6 [2.5] seconds.

Weakened Combatants become less accurate and slower.

Unique Weaken Effects:
Certain sources of Weaken inflict a dramatically stronger weaken that grants 30% [generally 50%] increased damage.

Shadowshot: Moebius grants 30% [50%] increased damage against tethered enemies.

Felwinter's Helm's Warlord's End grants 30% [30%] increased damage against enemies affected by its weakening burst.
Tractor Cannon's Repulsor Force and Fafnir (Quantum Nova Active) grants 30% [50%] increased damage against enemies it damages.
Fafnir's, Felwinter's, Tractor's weaken duration can be extended by any other Weaken effect.

Shadowshot: Deadfall uniquely grants 35% [50%?] increased damage against tethered enemies.
